issues.where: Lower crop, in the violet sky to the right of the lightning tip and beneath the diagonal ribbons
issues.what: The smooth falloff of the lightning glow breaks into rectangular patches with visible vertical seams.
issues.fix: Lower quantization in the low-contrast sky until the glow fades continuously.

issues.where: Lower right, in the spray below the pink horizon
issues.what: The stippled edge of the spray merges into broad soft clumps; nearby water ripples flatten into strips.
issues.fix: Give the spray and water more encoding bits so the clusters of droplets and gaps between ripples remain distinct.

issues.where: Lower crop, at the translucent curling strands extending right from the dark growth
issues.what: The narrow loops lose their separate outlines and merge into a gray smear against the sunset.
issues.fix: Reduce quantization around the low-contrast strands so the loops retain their contours.
